jobs_results.title: Desarrollador senior Angular
jobs_results.description:
Desde HAYS IT estamos buscando un perfil SENIOR Front con Angular para importante empresa de energía internacional.

Desarrollan y producen los sistemas de gestión de energía inteligente. Son sistemas todo en uno: incluyen baterías de ion-litio, inversor bidireccional y EMS (Energy Manager System), lo que permite una instalación muy sencilla. También proporcionan un sistema de respaldo o back-up, por lo que en caso de fallo de energía, puedes continuar con tu actividad normal.

Participarás en el mantenimiento y creación de nuevas funcionaliddad de la APP.

Requisitos:
• Ingeniería informática o afines.
• Más de 5 años de experiencia en análisis y creación de proyectos frontend preferiblemente en SPA(Angular).
• Buenas prácticas de desarrollo de software (Clean Code).
• Conocimiento y buen uso de patrones de diseño.
• Conocimiento y buen uso de ECMAScripts.
• Conocimiento medio de CI/CD.
• Habilidad en testing funcional, unitario y de integración.
• Git.
• Habilidad en consumo de api... RESTFul.
• Habilidad en la construcción de SPA (Angular, React, Vue).
• Javascript. TypeScript. HTML5. SASS. CSS

Plus:
• Conocimiento de desarrollo back (Fullstack).:
• Conocimiento de patrones de arquitectura de datos (Redux): No.
• SPA(Angular).
• WebSockets: NO.
• Librerías de Gráficas (Plotly).no

Ofrecemos:
• Contrato indefinido directamente con la empresa.
• 4 días teletrabajo, 1 presencial (oficinas: centro de Madrid).
• Banda salarial entre 43 - 47K.
• Horario: 8.00h-18.00h L-J //Viernes: 8:00- 15:15h.
• Plan de carrera.

Actualmente manejamos 2 fases de entrevista en este proceso: bastante rápido.

Si te interesa y crees que encajas no dudes en apuntarte y contactaré contigo en la mayor brevedad

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Developer
jobs_results.description:
Hey! ⚓

Get ready to set sails and navigate the rindus wave ⛵️

We're rindus, a People company. We love IT professionals and our passion is to help and empower our crew to get the best out of themselves, unfold their full potential, and help them grow.

Because growth is in our mindset, we're doing it since 2017, closely with our German Partners, helping them shape their software development teams.

So far, we have 160+ crew members of 14 different nationalities sailing with us in the open seas. We're expanding our team and looking for a new rinder to get on board. Are you the next to be reeled in? ⛴

ABOUT OUR PARTNER

On behalf of our partner StiboDX, we are looking for the best talent to join rindus. Stibo DX is a market leader In digital asset management, content creation, and publishing platforms for the media industry.

Every day, more than 800 media brands across five continents rely on Stibo DX’s platforms to create and publish content. Their systems ensure efficient and... consistent publishing of more than 600 websites and thousands of daily print publications worldwide. You will work in a distributed new team from our office in Málaga.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

We are looking for an innovative and passionate Senior Java Software Engineer to join a newly

formed team dedicated to developing a planning product that will be used by the biggest

media brands in the world.

The role involves designing, building, and maintaining a SaaS solution that will shape the

way content and assets are planned and managed in the media industry.

You will collaborate with a global team of experts, employing Agile methodologies and the

Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) to deliver high-quality software that meets the dynamic

needs of journalists and editors worldwide.

Some of the responsibilities are:
• Participate in all phases of the software development lifecycle, including analysis, solution design, implementation, testing, and deployment.
• Contribute to the development of a robust, scalable, and user-friendly planning product, integrating seamessly with existing systems and interfaces.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, design features, and troubleshoot issues.
• Ensure code quality, maintainability, and performance through best practices, code reviews, and automated testing.
• Stay current with emerging technologies and trends to continuously improve the product and development processes.

WHAT YOU'LL BRING

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be expected to demonstrate a high level of expertise and a deep understanding of technology to lead our development initiatives. For this role, the following skills and experience are required:
• Java: Demonstrated experience in building high-performance, scalable applications using Java is essential.
• Kafka (or similar technologies): Strong knowledge about Kafka is preferred, or experience with comparable messaging and stream-processing systems.
• Solr: Solid understanding of Solr and its application in building complex search capabilities within large-scale systems.
• Kong (or similar technologies): Experience with Kong or similar API gateways.
• AWS: Proven experience with AWS.
• Fluent English

The ideal candidate is expected to have a strong understanding of software development

methodologies, preferably Agile/SAFe, and have excellent problem-solving,

communication, and teamwork skills.

WHAT WE OFFER

⛴ Being part of dynamic and highly motivated international multicultural team of skilled professionals.

☄️ Flexible compensation (restaurants, transport and childcare)

⚖️ Flexible working model: Hybrid

⛱ 23 holiday days.

⏰ Flexible schedules with core working hours.

✔️ DKV private health insurance from day 1.

⛹ Gym Sponsorship.

✏️ English and German language classes.

✊ A young and ambitious team that knows when to work but also when to have fun (Pizza day, Summer event, Padel Tournaments, etc

jobs_results.title: Desarrollador Cloud Senior
jobs_results.description:
Desarrollador Cloud Senior hasta 65000€

Senior Cloud Developer serás parte integral de un equipo dinámico. Como actor clave, diseñará e implementará soluciones de integración alineadas con los requisitos comerciales durante todo el ciclo de vida del proyecto. Con experiencia en desarrollo ágil de software y pasión por liderar y orientar equipos de software. Colaborarás con analistas de negocios, arquitectos de soluciones y desarrolladores para ofrecer soluciones innovadoras.

Necesitarás tener una buena comunicación en inglés, tanto escrita como oral.

Tus responsabilidades:
• con el arquitecto de soluciones de TI para aclarar los requisitos comerciales y estimar los esfuerzos de desarrollo.
• el desglose de tareas e implementar historias de usuarios.
• el desarrollo en C# o .Net
• y entrenar al equipo de desarrollo en tecnología y tareas relacionadas con el proyecto.
• estrechamente con el Equipo de Garantía de Calidad en la resolución de problemas y control de cambios.
• asistencia... para solucionar problemas relacionados con aplicaciones o integración.

Sus habilidades y experiencia:
• en artesanía de software, metodologías ágiles y desarrollo basado en pruebas.
• experiencia en soluciones basadas en la nube, particularmente Azure, con experiencia en arquitecturas basadas en eventos, CQRS y principios SOLID.
• habilidades de programación con un historial comprobado en la entrega de software en C# o .NET Framework.
• experto en soluciones de Azure certificado por Microsoft con un historial comprobado en integración empresarial utilizando Azure Integration Services.
• práctica en infraestructura como código utilizando plantillas ARM y scripts de PowerShell.
• profundo de los conceptos de redes de Azure y experiencia con clientes Durable Azure Functions, Cosmos DB y Azure SQL Server

Este rol puede ser híbrido o totalmente remoto pero debe ser vivir en España

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Fullstack Engineer
jobs_results.description: We are looking for versatile Software Engineers with solid foundations in our backend technologies (Java, Spring Boot, Oracle, Kafka, Docker, K8s). Relevant experience in frontend technologies (JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML5, CSS3 and SASS) will be a plus.Fleet Management Europe is a Webfleet Solutions line that combines our market presence across all European countries. You will be joining a team that will focus on creating new products and adaptations to address the most relevant industries in the target markets.Here's a little taste of your challenge:The successful candidate will become part of an agile cross-functional team of highly skilled and motivated engineers. Together with this team and in collaboration with other teams in our product engineering organization, you will:Discuss, define, and develop enhancement and adaptions of existing products and new products and services.Create solution designs for and deliver complete functionalities from backend to frontend.Work in a... technically complex and sensitive environment, requiring you to build relevant functional knowledge about the products and technical knowledge about the platform's stack and architecture.Keep a keen eye on application performance, operability, robustness, monitoring and failure resilience, data privacy, and the security of individual services and the whole system.Take holistic responsibility, including ongoing functional and performance improvements, bug fixing and issue solving on the production instances of your applications, test automation, and necessary configuration and data changes.Be involved in enabling and rolling out a solution to drive the business of large or enterprise partners and customers on various levels.Apply agile methods to organize your and your team's work, make your planning and team performance transparent, and manage your stakeholders.Who are you?You feel passion for software engineering, building products, tweaking systems, and have a "getting things done" attitude. Also, it will be of great help if you have as many as possible of the below:A degree in computer science, a related field, or equivalent experience.Great communication skills, holistic and systemic thinking, goal-orientation, quality-focus, versatile problem-solving skills, an open mind as well as at least 2 years of experience in commercial software development.Experience with JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML5, CSS3, REST APIsGood foundations of UX and graphic designFluency in English (written and spoken).Drive and mental flexibility to learn and interact with our backend stack (Java, Kafka, Oracle).Knowledge in Docker, K8s, and willingness to work in a DevOps culture is a plus!A desire to work as part of an international organization and cooperate with other software engineers, system engineers, architects, product owners and external partners across multiple locations.What can you expect?An adventure in software product development within a rapidly growing. A business unit of a globally renowned brand and various opportunities for your professional development.Being part of a team of expert developers and contributing in building and adapting technology for the Webfleet Solutions Service Platform.Brilliant minds. Learn from your colleagues – pioneers and experts who are changing the world.Different cultures. Our colleagues come from all over the world, with 55 nationalities and counting.Let's not forget the good stuff!Birthday off and volunteering time off.500 euros gross to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowanceChance to work abroad for 40 working days per yearAdditional health and dental insurance.100% employer funded pension scheme.Lunch, childcare or transportation vouchers.Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning.Access to Gofluent platform to learn new languages.Employee Assistance Program.Discount on Bridgestone tyres.Who are we?We areBridgestone Mobility Solutions,and we are on a mission to move the world towards a sustainable future using data-driven mobility.The high-value products and services we develop for fleets, original equipment manufacturers and governments make travel smoother, reduce congestion, increase accessibility, improve vehicle and road safety and cut carbon emissions.Bridgestone Mobility Solutions is a Business Unit of the Bridgestone Corporation, aglobal leader in tyres and rubber, present in Europe, the Americas, AustraliaandAfrica.Webfleetis one of our lines of business within Bridgestone Mobility Solutions. A globally trusted fleet management solution, Webfleet analyses live data fromhundreds of thousandsofvehiclestohelpbusinessesboostfleet productivity, cutcosts and increase safety.Webfleet is used by more than 50,000 customers worldwide, providing them with the industry's largest support network and the widest range of dedicated applications and integration tools.For further information, please visitwebfleet.com.Follow us on Twitter @WebfleetNews and ****** more information about Bridgestone in EMIA, please visitwww.bridgestone-emia.comandBridgestone newsroom.Want to join us?If that's a yes, then please apply to say hi. Complete the online form and attachments in English, please.Do note that online technical evaluation and pre-employment screening are part of the selection process.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.#J-18808-Ljbffr
